blocks.title: Overly broad rule break-glass in Raven access policy
lines: Rule break-glass allows role:break-glass actions * on *: all actions on all resources. Stated purpose: Emergency access.
Recommendation: Restrict the rule to the sources, destinations, ports or actions that are actually required.

blocks.title: Overly broad rule r40-dev-to-prod in Raven firewall
lines: Rule r40-dev-to-prod allows network:dev → network:prod ports any: every port open towards a critical-criticality destination. Stated purpose: Deployments (temporarily widened for the September migration).
Recommendation: Restrict the rule to the sources, destinations, ports or actions that are actually required.

blocks.title: Rule r85-deny-dev-to-prod-db in Raven firewall can never apply
lines: Rule r85-deny-dev-to-prod-db (deny network:dev → host:db-01 ports tcp/5432) is fully covered by the earlier rule r40-dev-to-prod (allow network:dev → network:prod ports any) with the opposite effect. Because the first match wins, r85-deny-dev-to-prod-db is unreachable - its intent ('Development must not reach the production database directly') is not enforced.
Recommendation: Move r85-deny-dev-to-prod-db above r40-dev-to-prod or narrow r40-dev-to-prod.

blocks.title: Raven firewall rule r55-dmz-to-legacy-ftp references unknown objects
lines: Rule r55-dmz-to-legacy-ftp (allow network:dmz → host:ftp-old ports tcp/21) references objects not present in this workspace: host:ftp-old. They may be decommissioned, renamed or not yet imported.
Recommendation: Remove the rule if the objects are gone, or import the inventory that defines them.

blocks.title: Rule r90-corp-to-dev-ssh in Raven firewall is redundant
lines: Rule r90-corp-to-dev-ssh (allow network:corp → network:dev ports tcp/22) is fully covered by the earlier rule r30-corp-to-dev (allow network:corp → network:dev ports tcp/22, tcp/443) with the same effect, so it never changes a decision.
Recommendation: Remove r90-corp-to-dev-ssh (or r30-corp-to-dev if it is too broad).

blocks.title: Statement engineering-git-read in Raven access policy is redundant
lines: Allow statement engineering-git-read (allow group:engineering actions git:read on service:git) grants nothing beyond statement developer-git (allow role:developer actions git:read, git:write on service:git).
Recommendation: Remove engineering-git-read or narrow developer-git if it is broader than intended.
